title: Close the no-incident exception in building-guard-needs-incident
why: The rule says a new guard needs a named incident or a measured risk, then adds: 'A check that enforces a rule in this file needs no other incident.' So any CLAUDE.md rule can get a guard with no incident, and the freeze (c10) has a hole.
